If MICO mode is active, the UE can deactivate MICO mode at any time by activating the AS layer when the UE needs to send mobile originated signalling or user data. Otherwise, the UE shall not initiate any 5GMM procedure except for cell and PLMN reselection.

entities.name: MICO mode
entities.description: Mobile Initiated Connection Only mode where UE conserves power by only initiating connections when needed.

entities.name: AS layer activation
entities.description: Procedure where UE activates the Access Stratum layer to enable communication.

entities.name: Mobile originated signalling
entities.description: Condition where UE needs to send signalling initiated by the mobile device.

entities.name: Mobile originated user data
entities.description: Condition where UE needs to send user data initiated by the mobile device.

entities.name: Cell and PLMN reselection
entities.description: Procedure where UE performs cell and Public Land Mobile Network reselection.

entities.name: 5GMM procedure restriction
entities.description: Property that UE shall not initiate any 5GMM procedures except cell and PLMN reselection when coverage is lost or MICO mode is active.

relations.description: Activating AS layer deactivates MICO mode.
Mobile originated signalling requirement triggers AS layer activation.
Mobile originated user data requirement triggers AS layer activation.
Active MICO mode establishes restriction on 5GMM procedures.
Cell and PLMN reselection is an exception to the 5GMM procedure restriction.
